proof_0385.moves: States that scalar multiplication on the a.e.-equal-function quotient commutes with the quotient map mk; since the smul instance on AEEqFun is defined by lifting pointwise smul through the quotient, the equation holds by definition and is closed by rfl.

proof_0386.moves: The identity map is conformal, which is just the pointwise statement conformalAt_id asserted at every point; no real content beyond unfolding Conformal as 'ConformalAt everywhere'.

proof_0387.moves: Differentiability of the first component of a map into a product manifold: compose the given MDifferentiable map with the projection, which is itself MDifferentiable (mdifferentiable_fst), using the composition lemma.

proof_0388.moves: For a nonzero real exponent z, x^z = y^z iff x = y on NNReal: this is exactly injectivity of the base-wise rpow map, converted from an injectivity statement into an iff.

proof_0389.moves: Conditional probability times the measure of the conditioning set equals the measure of the intersection; obtained from the primed version, whose finiteness side condition is discharged by measure_ne_top for a finite measure.

proof_0390.moves: Globalizes the MeromorphicOn statement about the logarithmic derivative of a zpow: rewrite 'Meromorphic everywhere' as 'MeromorphicOn univ' and apply the set version on univ.

proof_0391.moves: An 'apply' lemma: the underlying function of the dilation equivalence given by left multiplication by a nonzero element is left multiplication; true by definition, closed by rfl.

proof_0392.moves: If two pairs of sets are a.e. equal then so are their symmetric differences; a direct application of the general filter-level EventuallyEq.symmDiff to the a.e. filter.

proof_0393.moves: A cyclotomic extension generated by a finite set of roots of unity is finite-dimensional: take the module-finiteness result IsCyclotomicExtension.finite and read it as finite dimensionality over the base field.

proof_0394.moves: Pure eta/notation variant: the sum of two functions differentiable at a point is differentiable there, restated with an explicit lambda instead of the pointwise-add notation. All content is in DifferentiableAt.add.

proof_0395.moves: Computes the fundamental-group map induced by an equality of basepoints on an element: it is conjugation by the eqToHom, which is exactly the groupoid lemma conj_eqToHom, with a symm to orient the equality.

proof_0396.moves: The coordinate map out of the L^p product is Lipschitz with the stated constant; the whole argument is delegated verbatim to a private auxiliary lemma proved earlier in the file.

proof_0397.moves: If the negation of f is Lipschitz on a set with constant K then so is f; take the forward direction of the iff characterizing Lipschitzness of -f.

proof_0398.moves: The inverse of the continuous linear equivalence attached to a linear isometry equivalence is the continuous linear equivalence of the inverse isometry; both sides unfold to the same data, so rfl.

proof_0399.moves: Two measures agreeing after restriction to each member of a countable cover of the space by measurable sets are equal; obtained by taking the mpr direction of the corresponding iff-form extensionality lemma.

proof_0400.moves: Sigma-finiteness of the measure with density the Radon-Nikodym derivative: the withDensity measure is dominated by the original measure, and a measure below a sigma-finite one is sigma-finite.

proof_0401.moves: A convenience variant of the congruence lemma for Frechet derivatives within a set: repackage the EqOn hypothesis plus membership of the base point into the form the existing congr lemma wants.

proof_0402.moves: Destructure the AEMeasurable hypothesis into a measurable representative g together with the a.e. equality f =ᵐ g; g is null measurable because measurable functions are, and null measurability transfers along the (reversed) a.e. equality. The witness extraction is the real first step and no citation names it.

proof_0403.moves: The first-marginal kernel is s-finite: rewrite fst as map along Prod.fst using fst_eq, then the s-finiteness of a mapped kernel is found by instance search. The proof is a rewrite plus typeclass resolution.

proof_0404.moves: Faithfulness of the discrete light-condensed-modules functor is transported along the natural isomorphism identifying it with the locally-constant functor, which is already known faithful; transport of a property along an iso is the whole argument.

proof_0405.moves: Primed restatement of the Fubini-style swap for integrals of a sum against a kernel composition-product; the argument shape differs only in how the function is presented, so the unprimed lemma is applied directly.

proof_0406.moves: The forgetful functor from affine schemes to schemes acts on morphisms as the identity on the underlying scheme morphism, since it is the full-subcategory inclusion; true by definition, closed by rfl.

proof_0407.moves: Variant of the congruence lemma for gradients within a set where the point is assumed to lie in the set; repackages hypotheses and applies HasGradientWithinAt.congr.

proof_0408.moves: A bump function is smooth: apply the general result that a bump built from smooth data is smooth, feeding it the smoothness of constants (the radii) and of the identity (the center/argument).
